messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 43(2)

Article 43 Procedure at national level for dealing with products within the scope of this Regulation presenting a risk. 2. Where the market surveillance authorities consider that non-compliance is not restricted to their national territory, they shall inform the Commission and the other Member States of the results of the evaluation and of the actions which they have required the economic operator to take.

response.text:
market surveillance authorities | shouldInformOf | the Commission and the other Member States | where they consider that non-compliance is not restricted to their national territory | "they shall inform the Commission and the other Member States"
market surveillance authorities | shouldReportEvaluationAndActions | the results of the evaluation and the actions they have required the economic operator to take | where they consider that non-compliance is not restricted to their national territory | "they shall inform the Commission and the other Member States of the results of the evaluation and of the actions which they have required the economic operator to take"
